item.title: Tampon Metals and the Vaginal Microbiome: The Blind Spot in the Risk Assessment
item.description: A toxicological risk assessment found tampon metals pose negligible systemic risk. But bioavailable there means absorbed into the blood, and the vaginal microbial community on the tampon surface was never assessed.
